+## reference · ChatGPT vs Perplexity AI Visibility (2026)
+
+### Scale & Audience
+*   **ChatGPT**: ~900M weekly active users (Feb 2026); ~2.5B prompts/day; ~64.6% of global generative AI web traffic. Audience skews mainstream (53–57% under 35; 73% non-work usage).
+*   **Perplexity**: ~22–45M monthly active users. Audience skews high-value decision-makers (80% college grads, 65% high-income, 30% senior leadership). Usage is 80%+ desktop with 11–12 min average session length.
+
+### Citation Mechanics
+*   **Overlap**: Only ~11% of domains are cited by both platforms. Visibility on one does not predict visibility on the other.
+*   **ChatGPT**:
+    *   Mentions brands 3.2× more often than it cites them with links (2.37 mentions vs. 0.73 citations per response).
+    *   Avg. 10.4 citations per response.
+    *   48.7% of citations come from third-party directories (Yelp, TripAdvisor, BBB).
+    *   67% of top 1,000 cited pages are "off-limits" to brand SEO (Wikipedia, gov/edu, major news).
+    *   28% of most-cited pages have zero Google organic visibility.
+*   **Perplexity**:
+    *   Avg. 21.9 citations per response (2× ChatGPT).
+    *   Generates 20× more website links than brand-name mentions ("ghost citations").
+    *   Extreme freshness bias: 82% citation rate for content updated within 30 days vs. 37% for older content.
+    *   Reads ~10 pages per query but cites only 3–4.
+    *   Top sources: Reddit (volatile post-Oct 2025 lawsuit), YouTube (~16.1% top-10 share), .edu, and government/medical publishers.
+
+### Traffic & Conversion
+*   **Traffic Share**: ChatGPT drives ~87.4% of all AI referral traffic; Perplexity drives ~2.8%; Gemini ~4.7%.
+*   **Conversion Rates**:
+    *   AI referrals generally convert higher than organic search (Adobe: +31% avg; Semrush: 4.4× organic).
+    *   Case study data: ChatGPT 15.9%, Perplexity 10.5%, Google Organic 1.76%.
+    *   **Caveat**: AI traffic underperforms Google organic by ~13% in impulse categories (apparel, grocery) but overperforms in research-heavy verticals (B2B SaaS, finance, electronics).
+
+### Monetization & Strategy (Post-Feb 2026)
+*   **ChatGPT**: Launched ads for free/Go-tier US users on Feb 9, 2026 (~$60 CPM). Paid placements are now available alongside organic.
+*   **Perplexity**: Abandoned advertising on Feb 18, 2026. **No paid visibility options exist**; organic citations are the only lever for brand visibility.
+*   **Strategic Implication**:
+    *   **ChatGPT**: Requires a hybrid strategy (paid + organic). Organic value increases as ad inventory grows, making it harder to distinguish editorial from paid mentions.
+    *   **Perplexity**: Requires strict focus on earned authority, freshness, and high-quality specialist sources.
+    *   **Tracking**: Monitor both platforms independently; rank tracking on one has limited predictive power for the other.
+
 Sources: https://quickseo.ai/blog/chatgpt-vs-perplexity-for-ai-visibility-in-2026-citations-traffic-and-conversion-compared
